caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, dark-colored rooster, positioned in profile, facing to the right. The rooster has a high, curved tail with three distinct tail feathers and a prominent, scalloped crest on top of its head. Its body is robust and rounded, featuring smooth, dark shading with subtle highlights and lighter outlining along some curves, especially at the edges of the wing and tail feathers. The rooster’s beak is pointed and light-colored at the tip, and it has a single round wattle beneath its beak. Its legs and feet are thin and straight, with three sharp toes that are dark but slightly lighter than the body. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present in the composition.
title: Small Iron Cock
